text: GET /v1/users/me - Retrieve your token's bot user.
GET /v1/users/{user_id} - Retrieve a user. Parameters: user_id [path] (required).
GET /v1/users - List all users. Parameters: start_cursor [query], page_size [query].
POST /v1/pages - Create a page. Parameters: filter_properties [query]. Request body fields: parent, properties, icon, cover, content, children, markdown, allow_async, template, position.
GET /v1/pages/{page_id} - Retrieve a page. Parameters: page_id [path] (required), filter_properties [query].

PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id} - Update page. Parameters: page_id [path] (required), filter_properties [query]. Request body fields: properties, icon, cover, is_locked, template, erase_content, in_trash, is_archived.
POST /v1/pages/{page_id}/move - Move a page. Parameters: page_id [path] (required). Request body fields: parent.
GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/properties/{property_id} - Retrieve a page property item. Parameters: page_id [path] (required), property_id [path] (required), start_cursor [query], page_size [query].
GET /v1/pages/{page_id}/markdown - Retrieve a page as markdown. Parameters: page_id [path] (required), include_transcript [query].

summary: Update a page's content as markdown
text: PATCH /v1/pages/{page_id}/markdown - Update a page's content as markdown. Parameters: page_id [path] (required). Accepts a request body.
GET /v1/async_tasks/{task_id} - Retrieve an async task. Parameters: task_id [path] (required).
GET /v1/blocks/{block_id} - Retrieve a block. Parameters: block_id [path] (required).
PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id} - Update a block. Parameters: block_id [path] (required). Accepts a request body.
DELETE /v1/blocks/{block_id} - Delete a block. Parameters: block_id [path] (required).
GET /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children - Retrieve block children. Parameters: block_id [path] (required), start_cursor [query], page_size [query].
PATCH /v1/blocks/{block_id}/children - Append block children. Parameters: block_id [path] (required). Request body fields: children, position.
GET /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id} - Retrieve a data source. Parameters: data_source_id [path] (required).
PATCH /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id} - Update a data source. Parameters: data_source_id [path] (required). Request body fields: title, icon, properties, in_trash, parent.

POST /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/query - Query a data source. Parameters: data_source_id [path] (required), filter_properties [query]. Request body fields: sorts, filter, start_cursor, page_size, is_archived, result_type.
POST /v1/data_sources - Create a data source. Request body fields: parent, properties, title, icon.

summary: List templates in a data source
text: GET /v1/data_sources/{data_source_id}/templates - List templates in a data source. Parameters: data_source_id [path] (required), name [query], start_cursor [query], page_size [query].
GET /v1/databases/{database_id} - Retrieve a database. Parameters: database_id [path] (required).
PATCH /v1/databases/{database_id} - Update a database. Parameters: database_id [path] (required). Request body fields: parent, title, description, is_inline, icon, cover, in_trash, is_locked.
POST /v1/databases - Create a database. Request body fields: parent, title, description, is_inline, initial_data_source, icon, cover.
POST /v1/search - Search by title. Request body fields: sort, query, start_cursor, page_size, filter.
POST /v1/comments - Create a comment. Accepts a request body.
GET /v1/comments - List comments. Parameters: block_id [query] (required), start_cursor [query], page_size [query].
GET /v1/comments/{comment_id} - Retrieve a comment. Parameters: comment_id [path] (required).
PATCH /v1/comments/{comment_id} - Update a comment. Parameters: comment_id [path] (required). Accepts a request body.
DELETE /v1/comments/{comment_id} - Delete a comment. Parameters: comment_id [path] (required).
POST /v1/file_uploads - Create a file upload. Request body fields: mode, filename, content_type, number_of_parts, external_url.
GET /v1/file_uploads - List file uploads. Parameters: status [query], start_cursor [query], page_size [query].
POST /v1/file_uploads/{file_upload_id}/send - Upload a file. Parameters: file_upload_id [path] (required). Accepts a request body.
POST /v1/file_uploads/{file_upload_id}/complete - Complete a multi-part file upload. Parameters: file_upload_id [path] (required).
GET /v1/file_uploads/{file_upload_id} - Retrieve a file upload. Parameters: file_upload_id [path] (required).
GET /v1/custom_emojis - List custom emojis. Parameters: start_cursor [query], page_size [query], name [query].
GET /v1/views - List views. Parameters: database_id [query], data_source_id [query], start_cursor [query], page_size [query].
POST /v1/views - Create a view. Request body fields: data_source_id, name, type, database_id, view_id, filter, sorts, quick_filters, create_database, configuration, position, placement.
GET /v1/views/{view_id} - Retrieve a view. Parameters: view_id [path] (required).
PATCH /v1/views/{view_id} - Update a view. Parameters: view_id [path] (required). Request body fields: name, filter, sorts, quick_filters, configuration.
DELETE /v1/views/{view_id} - Delete a view. Parameters: view_id [path] (required).
POST /v1/views/{view_id}/queries - Create a view query. Parameters: view_id [path] (required). Request body fields: page_size.
GET /v1/views/{view_id}/queries/{query_id} - Get view query results. Parameters: view_id [path] (required), query_id [path] (required), start_cursor [query], page_size [query].
DELETE /v1/views/{view_id}/queries/{query_id} - Delete a view query. Parameters: view_id [path] (required), query_id [path] (required).
POST /v1/blocks/meeting_notes - Create a meeting note. Accepts a request body.
POST /v1/blocks/meeting_notes/query - Query meeting notes. Request body fields: filter, sort, limit.

summary: Exchange an authorization code for an access and refresh token
text: POST /v1/oauth/token - Exchange an authorization code for an access and refresh token. Accepts a request body.
POST /v1/oauth/revoke - Revoke a token. Request body fields: token.
POST /v1/oauth/introspect - Introspect a token. Request body fields: token.
